controlKdf.macRule: HMAC-SHA-256(directionKey32,DBR2.GetAuthenticationInput); constant-time comparison before committed or candidate Braid mutation
controlKdf.linkEpochRule: DBR2.braidEpoch-1; retain with actual SPQR link; install only on genuine Braid output

controlSlots.rule: fixed slots, no contiguous-first-slot requirement when data already carried an earlier flight; send-slot reuse rejects; exact received full-frame hash replays without mutation; changed slot or cross-slot operation reuse rejects

privateState.slotLayout: two ascending slot entries, each32; mask bits0/1; present operation/hash nonzero32; absent all-zero32; no repeated operation across retained send/receive slots
privateState.rule: no generation1 reader; unused whole link all zero; roots/operations/hashes wiped on retirement/disposal; masks have no other bits

candidateRule: only verified current internal state/binding and owner network scope; no public raw-key author/verifier or durable receipt; preserve outer data cursors/frontiers/evidence/skipped keys/freshness counters; storageGeneration+1 only for fresh control; exact replay has no successor
activationRule: internal component candidate only; durable SQL/floor/unknown/crash/cancel, transport/ACK, public API/package and device activation remain gated
